emotions.sub: Understand happy, sad, angry, scared & calm feelings

routine.sub: Morning sequence from waking up to school time

brushTeeth.title: Brush Teeth Twice a Day
brushTeeth.desc: Brushing your teeth in the morning and before bed keeps your smile sparkling clean and strong!
brushTeeth.tip: Brush gently in small circles for 2 whole minutes!

washHands.title: Wash Hands with Soap
washHands.desc: Washing hands with soap and water before eating and after playing washes away all germs!
washHands.tip: Sing 'Happy Birthday' or count to 20 while scrubbing bubbles!

dailyBath.title: Take a Fresh Daily Bath
dailyBath.desc: A warm bath or shower washes away sweat and dirt so you feel fresh and energetic all day!
dailyBath.tip: Wash all over and dry thoroughly with a soft clean towel!

cleanClothes.title: Wear Clean Clothes
cleanClothes.desc: Wearing fresh, washed clothes every morning protects your skin and keeps you smelling nice!
cleanClothes.tip: Place dirty clothes in the laundry basket like a helpful champ!

coverCough.title: Cover Coughs & Sneezes
coverCough.desc: Cover your mouth with your elbow or tissue when coughing to keep your friends and family healthy!
coverCough.tip: The elbow shield is the superhero way to stop germs from spreading!

combHair.title: Comb & Tidy Your Hair
combHair.desc: Gently brushing or combing your hair keeps it neat, untangled, and tidy for school!
combHair.tip: Always keep your hairbrush clean and in its proper place!

happy.name: Happy
happy.desc: You feel joyful, smiling, and full of sunshine inside!
happy.tip: Share your smile and do fun activities with family and friends!

sad.name: Sad
sad.desc: You might feel like crying or sitting quietly when something hurts or is lost.
sad.tip: It is okay to cry. Asking for a warm hug from someone you love helps so much!

angry.name: Angry
angry.desc: Your heart beats fast and your face might feel hot when things feel unfair.
angry.tip: Take 3 deep slow breaths: smell the flowers, blow out the birthday candles!

scared.name: Scared
scared.desc: You might feel jumpy or want to hide when something seems spooky or new.
scared.tip: Hold a grown-up's hand or talk to a parent. You are safe!

tired.name: Tired
tired.desc: Your eyes feel heavy and your body has low energy after playing hard.
tired.tip: Drink a sip of water, rest on your cozy bed, and take a peaceful nap!

calm.name: Calm
calm.desc: Your body is relaxed, your mind is peaceful, and everything feels quiet and safe.
calm.tip: Enjoy listening to birds singing, drawing pictures, or reading a nice book!

scenarios.s1Story: Anya receives a surprise birthday gift with her favorite toy inside!
scenarios.s1Expl: Anya feels super Happy 😀 and excited!
scenarios.s2Story: Leo accidentally drops his favorite drawing in a puddle of water.
scenarios.s2Expl: Leo feels Sad 😢, which is completely natural.
scenarios.s3Story: Maya's tower of blocks is knocked over before she could show her family.
scenarios.s3Expl: Maya feels Angry 😡, but taking deep breaths will help her feel better.
scenarios.s4Story: There is a sudden loud thunder sound outside the window during rain.
scenarios.s4Expl: The loud noise can make a child feel Scared 😨.
scenarios.s5Story: Sam played soccer at the playground all afternoon in the park.
scenarios.s5Expl: After running and playing, Sam feels Tired 😴 and ready to rest.
scenarios.s6Story: Mia is curled up in a cozy beanbag reading her favorite picture storybook.
scenarios.s6Expl: Mia feels peaceful, relaxed, and Calm 😌.

manners.m1Story: You are sitting at the table and want a glass of milk from mom.
manners.m2Story: Your friend gives you a shiny birthday sticker.
manners.m3Story: You were running and accidentally bumped into your classmate's desk.
manners.m4Story: Two adults are talking and blocking the doorway you need to walk past.
manners.m5Story: You have two toy race cars and your little brother wants to play too.
manners.m6Story: Three children are standing in front of you waiting for the big slide.
manners.pleaseWord: Say: 'May I please have some milk?'
manners.pleaseFeedback: Saying 'Please' is a wonderful magic word that shows respect!
manners.politeHint: Using the magic word 'Please' makes people happy to help you.
manners.thankYouWord: Say: 'Thank you so much!' with a smile
manners.walkAway: Take it and walk away without saying anything
manners.thankYouFeedback: 'Thank you' shows gratitude and makes your friend feel appreciated!
manners.thankYouHint: Saying 'Thank you' shows love and kindness for gifts.
manners.sorryWord: Say: 'I am so sorry! Are you okay?'
manners.blameOther: Pretend nothing happened or blame someone else
manners.sorryFeedback: Saying 'Sorry' bravely fixes mistakes and heals feelings!
manners.sorryHint: Apologizing with 'Sorry' is how super kids take responsibility.
manners.excuseMeWord: Say: 'Excuse me please, may I pass?'
manners.pushThrough: Push right through them with your elbows
manners.excuseFeedback: 'Excuse me' is the gentle, polite way to walk through or ask for attention!
manners.excuseHint: Saying 'Excuse me' is gentle and avoids bumping into others.
manners.keepAll: Hide both cars and refuse to share
manners.shareFeedback: Sharing toys doubles the fun and builds great friendships!
manners.shareHint: Sharing creates happy smiles for everyone.
manners.waitTurn: Stand in line patiently and wait for your turn
manners.cutLine: Push to the front and skip the line
manners.turnFeedback: Taking turns is fair and keeps everyone safe and smiling!
manners.turnHint: Patiently waiting for your turn is a fantastic superpower.

fruitsVeggies.title: Eat Colorful Fruits & Veggies
fruitsVeggies.desc: Crunchy apples, carrots, and bananas give your body vitamins and superpowers!

drinkWater.title: Drink Fresh Water
drinkWater.desc: Water keeps your brain sharp, cool, and refreshed throughout the day!

goodSleep.title: Get 9-10 Hours of Sleep
goodSleep.desc: Going to bed on time helps your body grow taller and rest your brain!

activePlay.title: Active Movement & Play
activePlay.desc: Running, jumping, dancing, and playing games make your heart and muscles strong!

healthyBreakfast.title: Nutritious Breakfast
healthyBreakfast.desc: A morning meal gives you the energy to learn, play, and smile all morning!

outdoorSun.title: Fresh Air & Sunshine
outdoorSun.desc: Playing outside in nature helps you absorb natural vitamin D and feel cheerful!

crossRoad.title: Crossing the Street
crossRoad.rule: Always hold a grown-up's hand. Stop, look left and right before crossing!
crossRoad.choice: Cross at pedestrian zebra crossings with an adult.

bikeHelmet.title: Bicycle & Scooter Helmet
bikeHelmet.rule: Always strap on your helmet before riding your bicycle or scooter.
bikeHelmet.choice: Protect your head every time you ride wheels.

stayClose.title: Staying Near Family in Crowds
stayClose.rule: In malls, markets, or parks, always stay right by your parent's side.
stayClose.choice: Hold hands or keep your family in clear sight.

hotStove.title: Kitchen & Hot Stoves
hotStove.rule: Never touch hot pots, pans, ovens, or matchsticks in the kitchen.
hotStove.choice: Keep a safe distance from cooking stoves.

waterSafety.title: Swimming & Water Safety
waterSafety.rule: Never swim alone. Always have an adult watching you by the water.
waterSafety.choice: Wear floaties and follow lifeguard instructions.

sharpObjects.title: Scissors & Tools
sharpObjects.rule: Use child-safe scissors and never run while holding pens or tools.
sharpObjects.choice: Always carry scissors pointing downwards with care.

quiz.q1: When should you brush your teeth?
quiz.q1Opt1: Twice a day: in the morning and before bed (🪥)
quiz.q1Expl: Brushing in the morning and at night keeps teeth cavity-free 🪥!
quiz.q2: What should you use to wash away germs on your hands?
quiz.q2Opt2: Just wipe hands on your shirt (👕)
quiz.q2Expl: Soap and warm water wash away germs completely 🧼!
quiz.q3: What magic word do you say when someone gives you a gift?
quiz.q4: What is a kind way to play with toys when friends are around?
quiz.q4Opt2: Hide all toys in a cupboard (🔒)
quiz.q4Opt3: Run away with all the toys (🏃)
quiz.q4Expl: Sharing toys makes playtime fun for everyone 🧸!
quiz.q5: If your friend is feeling sad, what can you do?
quiz.q5Opt1: Offer a kind word, listening ear, or a hug (🤗)
quiz.q5Expl: Kindness and empathy comfort our friends ❤️!
quiz.q6: How should you cover your mouth when sneezing?
quiz.q6Opt1: Inside your elbow or with a tissue (💪)
quiz.q6Expl: The elbow shield blocks germs from spreading 🤧!
quiz.q7: How do you cross a street safely?
quiz.q7Opt1: Hold an adult's hand and look both ways (🤝 🚦)
quiz.q7Opt2: Run across with your eyes closed (🏃 💨)
quiz.q7Expl: Always hold hands, stop, look, and listen 🚦!
quiz.q8: Why are fruits and vegetables good for your body?
quiz.q8Opt1: They give you vitamins, energy, and strong muscles (💪 🌟)
quiz.q8Opt2: They make you super sleepy instantly (😴)
quiz.q8Expl: Nutritious foods help your body grow strong 🍎 🥦!
quiz.q9: What comes right after waking up in your morning routine?
quiz.q9Opt1: Brush your teeth and wash your face (🪥 ✨)
quiz.q9Opt2: Run out the door without shoes (🎒 🏫)
quiz.q9Expl: Brushing teeth is the first fresh morning step 🪥!
quiz.q10: What must you wear on your head when riding a bicycle?
quiz.q10Expl: A helmet protects your head every single ride 🚲 ⛑️!

car.title: Car
car.purpose: A car travels on roads on four wheels and takes family and friends to wonderful places!
car.fact: Cars use headlights to see at night and seatbelts to keep everyone safe and cozy!

bus.title: Bus
bus.purpose: A bus is a big road vehicle that carries lots of children to school and people across town!
bus.fact: School buses are often bright yellow and stop safely to let kids hop on and off!

ambulance.title: Ambulance
ambulance.purpose: An ambulance rushes sick or hurt people quickly and safely to the hospital!
ambulance.fact: It has flashing blue/red lights and loud sirens so cars move aside to let it pass fast!

fireTruck.title: Fire Truck
fireTruck.purpose: A fire truck carries firefighters, long hoses, and water ladders to extinguish fires!
fireTruck.fact: Firefighters wear heat-proof coats and helmets to rescue people and pets safely!

police.title: Police Car
police.purpose: A police car helps police officers patrol the city and keep our neighborhoods safe!
police.fact: Police officers are friendly community helpers you can always ask for help!

airplane.title: Airplane
airplane.purpose: An airplane flies high above the clouds across oceans and countries with big wings!
airplane.fact: Pilots fly planes from the cockpit and take off from airport runways!

ship.title: Ship
ship.purpose: A ship is a giant vessel that sails safely across deep oceans carrying travelers and cargo!
ship.fact: Ships use heavy metal anchors to stay parked in harbors without drifting away!

train.title: Train
train.purpose: A train connects many passenger coaches and zooms smoothly over steel railway tracks!
train.fact: Trains make a cheerful 'Choo-choo!' horn sound when arriving at stations!

bicycle.title: Bicycle
bicycle.purpose: A bicycle has two wheels and pedals that make you healthy and strong as you ride!
bicycle.fact: Always remember your bicycle helmet and bell for safety on paths!

doctor.title: Doctor
doctor.purpose: A doctor listens to your heartbeat with a stethoscope and helps you get well when sick!
doctor.fact: Doctors work in clinics and hospitals with caring nurses and medicine!

teacher.title: Teacher
teacher.purpose: A teacher guides children in classrooms, teaching reading, math, science, and kindness!
teacher.fact: Teachers love when curious students ask questions and share happy stories!

chef.title: Chef
chef.purpose: A chef prepares delicious, nutritious, and appetizing meals in kitchens and restaurants!
chef.fact: Chefs often wear a tall white hat called a toque to keep kitchen spaces clean!

farmer.title: Farmer
farmer.purpose: A farmer plants seeds, tends crops, and grows fresh fruits, vegetables, and grains on farms!
farmer.fact: Farmers drive tractors and care for cows, sheep, and chickens on green fields!

pilot.title: Pilot
pilot.purpose: A pilot guides airplanes safely through the sky to distant cities and continents!
pilot.fact: Pilots study weather maps and talk with air traffic controllers through headsets!

builder.title: Builder
builder.purpose: A builder uses bricks, cement, and tools to construct strong houses, bridges, and schools!
builder.fact: Builders wear hard safety hats and sturdy boots on construction sites!

eiffel.title: Eiffel Tower
eiffel.purpose: The Eiffel Tower is a magnificent iron tower standing proudly in Paris, France!
eiffel.fact: At night, thousands of twinkling golden lights sparkle over the Paris skyline!

taj.title: Taj Mahal
taj.purpose: The Taj Mahal is a breathtaking white marble monument in Agra, India!
taj.fact: It is recognized worldwide as one of the New Seven Wonders of the World!

statue.title: Statue of Liberty
statue.purpose: The Statue of Liberty is a grand green copper statue holding a torch of freedom!
statue.fact: She wears a crown with 7 spikes representing the 7 oceans and continents of the Earth!

pyramids.title: Great Pyramids
pyramids.purpose: The Pyramids are ancient stone wonders built thousands of years ago in the desert!
pyramids.fact: They were built with massive stone blocks aligned precisely with the stars!

colosseum.title: Colosseum
colosseum.purpose: The Colosseum is a grand oval amphitheater built in ancient Rome, Italy!
colosseum.fact: Thousands of spectators used to gather there for historic festival games!

trees.title: Green Trees
trees.purpose: Trees absorb carbon dioxide and release fresh, clean oxygen for all of us to breathe!
trees.fact: Trees provide sweet fruits, cool shade on sunny days, and homes for birds!

rainbow.title: Rainbow
rainbow.purpose: A rainbow forms when bright sunshine shines through tiny falling raindrops!
rainbow.fact: A rainbow has 7 magical colors: Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, and Violet!

recycling.title: Recycling
recycling.purpose: Recycling transforms used paper, cardboard, and clean containers into brand-new items!
recycling.fact: Putting paper in recycling bins saves trees and keeps parks sparkly clean!

diwali.title: Diwali
diwali.purpose: Diwali is a joyful celebration of light, warmth, hope, and new beginnings!
diwali.fact: Families light small clay lamps called diyas, make colorful rangoli, and share sweets!

christmas.title: Christmas
christmas.purpose: Christmas is a festive winter holiday celebrating love, peace, and family togetherness!
christmas.fact: People decorate evergreen pine trees with shiny stars, ornaments, and exchange gifts!

eid.title: Eid
eid.purpose: Eid is a beautiful celebration of gratitude, prayer, family meals, and charity!
eid.fact: People greet each other with 'Eid Mubarak!', wear festive clothes, and share feast dishes!

toothbrush.title: Toothbrush
toothbrush.purpose: A toothbrush with soft bristles keeps our teeth shining white, strong, and cavity-free!
toothbrush.fact: Brushing in small circles for 2 minutes morning and night gives super-healthy teeth!

pencil.title: Pencil
pencil.purpose: A pencil lets children write stories, solve math problems, and draw colorful art!
pencil.fact: Pencil marks can be erased cleanly with a soft rubber eraser!

umbrella.title: Umbrella
umbrella.purpose: An umbrella opens wide to shield you from raindrops or strong midday sun rays!
umbrella.fact: Umbrellas come in rainbow colors and fold down small into backpacks!

sunny.title: Sunny Day
sunny.purpose: The sun shines brightly in the clear sky, giving warmth and energy to plants and animals!
sunny.fact: Wearing a sunhat and drinking fresh water keeps you cool during outdoor sunny play!

rainy.title: Rainy Day
rainy.purpose: Rain clouds bring water droplets from the sky to fill rivers, lakes, and nourish green trees!
rainy.fact: Rain boots let you jump happily in splashy puddles on the sidewalk!

challenge.title: GK Master Arena
challenge.q1: Which red emergency truck carries ladders and puts out fires?
challenge.exp1: Fire trucks extinguish fires with water ladders 🚒!
challenge.q2: Who checks our health with a stethoscope when we feel sick?
challenge.exp2: Doctors take care of our health 👨‍⚕️!
challenge.q3: Which iconic iron tower sparkles at night in Paris, France?
challenge.exp3: The Eiffel Tower stands in Paris 🗼 🇫🇷!
challenge.q4: Why are green trees so important for people and animals?
challenge.exp4: Trees produce fresh oxygen for breathing 🍃 💨!
challenge.q5: Which festival is celebrated by lighting small clay diya lamps?
challenge.exp5: Diwali is the Festival of Lights 🪔 ✨!
challenge.q6: What object with soft bristles do we use to brush our teeth?
challenge.exp6: A toothbrush keeps teeth white and clean 🪥!
challenge.q7: Who flies large passenger airplanes through the sky?
challenge.q8: Which white marble world wonder is located in Agra, India?
challenge.exp8: The Taj Mahal is in Agra, India 🕌 🇮🇳!
challenge.q9: What should you carry when stepping outside on a rainy afternoon?
challenge.exp9: An umbrella or raincoat keeps you dry ☂️ 🧥!
challenge.q10: What does recycling paper and plastic help accomplish?
challenge.exp10: Recycling transforms waste into new items ♻️ 🌟!
